about_the_game:
This demo is a preview of the game's development. Thanks to your feedback, we'll be able to tweak our concepts for the final game.

The following gameplay features are available and may change for the full release:

  • Automated sailing

  • Dynamic landscape

  • Day/night cycle

  • Weather events

  • Active fishing

  • Passive collection systems

  • Buildings to sell your fishes & artifacts

  • Tool purchasing

  • Leaderboards

  • Companions to help you collect artifacts

  • An encyclopedia tracking all fish caught and artifacts found

To learn more, visit our Steam page and join our Discord to chat with us!
